name: Hydrochlorothiazide
description: A thiazide diuretic inhibiting the sodium-chloride cotransporter in the distal convoluted tubule, approved for hypertension and oedema.

systems.note: Blood pressure reduction; the labelled indication.
Hypokalaemia, hyponatraemia and hypomagnesaemia are labelled and characteristic, as are hyperuricaemia and precipitation of gout.

monitors.why: Hypokalaemia is the characteristic labelled electrolyte disturbance.
Hyponatraemia is labelled and can be severe.
Labelled hyperuricaemia and precipitation of gout.
Thiazides reduce urinary calcium excretion and raise serum calcium.
